Author: Ajay Bhanot

HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD ?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:AHC:88118 Court No. - 64 Case :- CRIMINAL MISC. BAIL APPLICATION No. - 12611 of 2024 Applicant :- Parmanand Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Ashish Gupta Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.
Matter is taken up in the revised call.

By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.
54 of 2024 at Police Station- Raunapar, District- Azamgarh under Sections 376, 323, 504, 506 IPC.
The applicant is in jail since 10.02.2024.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 18.03.2024.

The following arguments made by Sri Ashish Gupta, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant,
which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Sri Rishi Chadha, learned AGA from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
Parmanand vs State Of U.P. on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82030948/
1
1. The applicant is the brother-in-law of the victim.
The two families traced their origin to a common ancestor.
There is a dispute between the parties pertaining to ancestral property.
2. The applicant has been falsely nominated only to leverage the criminal case in the property dispute and settle the same on the terms of the first informant's family.
3. As per the prosecution case, the incident occurred in the dead of night at the house of the victim.
There is no sign of forced entry.
The victim never raised an alarm.
Her family members were not alerted to the presence of an intruder or the incident.
Prosecution case is inherently false and liable to be disbelieved.
4. There was an altercation between the parties over the partition of the property.
5. The victim's family had dialed the emergency number and the police promptly reached the site.
However, no allegation of rape was made to the said police party.
6. Material witnesses which include the family of the victim have not been examined.
7. False and aggravated allegations have been made by the victim against the applicant in her statements under Section 161 Cr.P.C. and 164 Cr.P.C. only to save the failing prosecution case.

8. Major inconsistencies in the statements of the victim under Sections 161 Cr.P.C.
and Section 164 Cr.P.C. as well as the recitals in the F.I.R. discredit the prosecution case.
9. Medical evidence to establish the commission of rape by the applicant with the victim has not been produced by the prosecution.
10. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
11. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant- Parmanand be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
Parmanand vs State Of U.P. on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82030948/
2
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

(iii) The learned trial court is directed to fix the sureties after due application of mind in light of the judgement passed by this Court in Arvind Singh v. State of U.P. Thru.
Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. (Application U/S 482 No.2613 of 2023).
The learned trial court shall ensure that the right of bail of the applicant granted by this Court is not frustrated by arbitrary demands of sureties or onerous conditions which are unrelated to the socioeconomic status of the applicant.
Order Date :- 15.5.2024
